dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh... Is it too noisy here?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: It's just... you've been my guest so often up till now. Now that I am suddenly the guest, I find myself unused to it.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: What should I do? Chat with you? Or perhaps play games together?

choices.text: Just think of this place as your "home"...

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: Really? Hmm... In that case, can I stroll about, singing as I do?

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: Can I take a nap anywhere I choose, should I wish to rest?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Holler if you need a pillow.

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: And would it be all right to pick some of the plants you've planted? You know, as you sometimes do with Moonfall Silver at Silvermoon Hall?

choices.text: So you knew the whole time...

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: Haha, only a jest. So long as they will help you on your journey, I would never object.

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: You've created a very pleasant environment here. I'm already satisfied to just enjoy it in peace.

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: I wonder... should I try decorating Silvermoon Hall as well?

choices.text: So, you've been holding a grudge...
Do what you feel like doing.
